changelog:
- Added initial documentation and guidelines for the new "field-check-set" skill.
- Outlines process to turn user-supplied on-site inspection check items into a matching field check still pack (4–8 stills).
- Defines clear steps for collecting inputs, planning, approval, creation, billing, and delivery of field check packs.
- Specifies one still per named check item; no invention of missing data or results.
- Details strict workflow integration with Beatra's system and packaged MCP client tools.
- Includes instructions for safe, automatic updates and task/billing recovery procedures.
summary: Turn user-supplied on-site inspection check item names and check points into a four-to-eight still field check set. This check-item-to-still studio lays out each named inspection item as its own on-site check still. Use it for field check still packs, inspection checklist graphics, and matching on-site inspection still sets.
